title: I Betrayed My Vampire Groom
logline: A hunter exposes her vampire groom at their wedding to avenge her sister, only to learn the dead woman may be alive—and transformed.
target_audience: US women ages 18-34 drawn to forbidden supernatural romance, betrayal reveals, revenge, and high-stakes cliffhangers.
hook: At her wedding altar, Mara drops Lucien's ring and announces, "My groom is a vampire—and I brought hunters."
synopsis: Undercover hunter Mara interrupts her own vows to expose Lucien, the vampire groom she genuinely loves. A flashback shows that Voss sent her to avenge her murdered sister. But once Lucien is captured, he claims Voss forged the evidence—and Mara's supposedly dead sister enters the chapel as a vampire, forcing Mara to defy her commander and demand the truth.
episode_goal: Have Mara publicly expose and betray her vampire groom, then overturn her revenge narrative with proof that her hunter commander lied.
